axes.question: How fragmented is the collection system: how many competent structures, what coexistence of financing/modes, what does that mean for the user?
Who pays what: TEOM vs REOM vs incentive pricing, how many inhabitants covered, what are the territorial inequalities?
What is the performance and cost ledger: 615kg/hab, three circuits, treatment installations, 21.6 Md EUR spending?

causal.cause: Legally permitted organisational freedom (L2224-13: communes/EPCI/syndicats can each organise collection), historic mixed financing, 1,169 structures
causal.effect: Heterogeneous collection systems: different bins, frequencies, financing across neighbouring territories - the perceived bordel
causal.mechanism: Each structure decides modalities within a minimal frame (weekly PAP >2000 hab, 4 separate streams); financement mixte only legal for historic reasons (fusions, syndicats)

causal.cause: TEOM classic is assessed on property rental value, not on waste produced (72% of population)
causal.effect: No price signal on quantities thrown away; DMA at 615 kg/hab and LTECV -10% 2020 target missed
causal.mechanism: TEOM decouples payment from usage; TI (REOMi/TEOMi) restores the signal and cuts OMR -31%

causal.cause: Decheteries collect 40% of DMA tonnage (99% rubble, 88% bulky) - co-equal with residual collection
causal.effect: Any access-control or exclusion policy at decheteries directly moves a major share of household waste flows
causal.mechanism: The 40% share (Insee/ADEME 2021) makes decheterie access policy a waste-policy lever of the first order, connecting this investigation to the decheteries dossier

claims.claim: The perceived collection bordel is structural: 1,169 competent structures, legally permitted mixed financing (TEOM+REOM on one territory for historic reasons), modalities left to each collectivite within a minimal weekly PAP + 4-stream frame
claims.counter: The fragmentation has been halved since 2007 (mutualisation) and stabilised since 2017
claims.gap: No national per-EPCI collection-mode map published

claims.claim: TEOM classic (not based on waste produced) remains the dominant financing mode: ~63% of structures, 72% of the population (48.8M inhabitants) - the majority pays a tax decoupled from what they throw away
claims.gap: No consolidated per-EPCI TEOM rate map

claims.claim: Incentive pricing is documented as effective (OMR -31%, packaging +17%) but marginal: 7.2M inhabitants vs the 25M LTECV target; ADEME shows TI does not systematise wild dumping
claims.counter: TI blamed for wild dumps in public debate; 3+ years lead time and logistics slow roll-out
claims.gap: No national per-EPCI TI tariff/impact series

claims.claim: Collection runs on three co-equal circuits: residual waste ~40% of tonnage (door-to-door), separate collection ~20%, decheteries 40% (99% of rubble, 88% of bulky) - the user faces different bins, schedules, drop points and prices depending on where they live

facts.subject: Nombre de structures competentes collecte/traitement
facts.value: In 2023, 1,169 structures held the waste collection/treatment competence (ADEME 2025 survey, cited by Senate PPL l25-049 report): 6 communes in own hands (Paris + mono-communal islands Sein, Ouessant, Brehat, Yeu). Count nearly halved between 2007 and 2023 (mutualisation), stabilising since 2017.

facts.subject: TEOM classique premier mode de financement
facts.value: Classic TEOM remains the leading financing mode: ~63% of the 1,169 structures, serving 72% of French population (48.8M inhabitants). Breakdown of modes: TEOM+RS 33.3%, TEOM 21.3%, REOM-I 14.0%, REOM 9.6%, mixed financing 7.4%, budget general 0.9%, others minor.

facts.subject: Financement mixte TEOM+REOM meme territoire
facts.value: Mixed financing (part of the EPCI territory in TEOM, another in REOM, sometimes with special levy) is legally possible ONLY for 'historic' reasons: commune fusions or syndicates gathering EPCI members in different regimes. Same territory can therefore host different financing and collection rules - a structural source of perceived 'bordel'.

facts.subject: Tarification incitative 7,2M habitants vs objectif 25M
facts.value: Only 7.2M French inhabitants are covered by incentive pricing (TI) today, far from the 25M target set by LTECV; coverage grew +44% since 2016 but generalisation faces individualisation issues in urban/tourist areas, heavy investment and admin cost, variable revenue. ADEME estimates TI cuts residual household waste (OMR) by 30%.

facts.subject: TI et depots sauvages
facts.value: TI is popularly blamed for wild dumping, but ADEME finds 'the incentive tax does not systematise the emergence of wild dumps' where good practices exist; household waste is a tiny share of wild dumps vs professional waste. The Senate finance committee repeated this caveat (2025).

facts.subject: Obligations de collecte PAP hebdo + 4 filieres separees
facts.value: Regulation mandates at minimum weekly door-to-door collection in agglomerated zones above 2,000 permanent inhabitants, and 4 mandatory separate collection streams: (1) paper/glass/metal/plastic, (2) mineral/wood/plaster construction waste, (3) textile and hazardous waste, (4) biowaste. All modalities left to each collectivite within this frame.

facts.subject: PPL modulation sociale REOM/TEOMi rejetee commission
facts.value: Senate finance committee (rapporteur Olivier Paccaud, 21/10/2025) did NOT adopt article 1 of the PPL 'garantir la qualite des services de gestion des dechets': a proposed social modulation of REOM/TEOMi by income, household composition or health. The PPL itself signals the fragmentation/quality concern is on the legislative agenda.

facts.subject: TI 1er janvier 2021 200 collectivites
facts.value: ADEME (Bilan des collectivites en TI au 1er janvier 2021, rapport 2024): 200 collectivites had successfully set up incentive pricing covering 6.6M inhabitants - 176 with incentive levy (REOMi), 24 with incentive tax (TEOMi). Majority rural or 'mixed rural-dominant' typology; developing in denser and tourist areas.

facts.subject: Effets TI OMR emballages verre decheteries
facts.value: ADEME SINOE data on TI effects: DMA -5% average; residual household waste (OMR) -31% average (-34% under REOMi, -16% TEOMi); separate packaging/paper collection +17%; glass +10%; flows to decheteries +13%. TI cuts volumes most where the service is individually billed.

facts.subject: Delai mise en place TI 3 ans
facts.value: ADEME: at least 3 years between the elected decision and effective billing of an incentive levy (REOMi), +1 year for incentive tax (TEOMi). Requires bacs with chips, taxpayer/producer files, blank billing test - heavy logistics explaining slow national roll-out.

facts.subject: Etude TI incivilites 28 collectivites
facts.value: ADEME/ECOGEOS/ALTAIR study (2024) observed 28 collectivites (18 in TI, 10 control): field measurements show TI does not systematise wild dumps of residual waste; annual OMR wild-dump estimates remain moderate vs TI benefits (~30% OMR reduction).

facts.subject: DMA 2021 615 kg/hab OMR 245 kg
facts.value: Insee Premiere 2055 (data 2021, mainland+Reunion): 41Mt DMA collected, 615 kg/hab (+4% in 10 years; LTECV -10% 2020 target missed). Residual waste (OMR) 245.1 kg/hab (-14% vs 286.4 in 2011); sorted waste 369.6 kg/hab (+21%). More waste collected in tourist zones; less and better sorted under incentive pricing; more with income and commercial density.

facts.subject: 3 circuits collecte OMR 40 pourcent decheteries 40 pourcent
facts.value: Three collection circuits in 2021: residual waste ~40% of tonnage (door-to-door mixed bins), separate collection ~20% (door-to-door tri bins or voluntary drop points PAV), decheteries 40% (incl. 99% of rubble, 88% of bulky waste, 78% of green waste/biowaste). Decheteries are co-equal to residual collection.

facts.subject: 1800 installations de traitement 2022
facts.value: In 2022 France had ~1,800 waste treatment installations: 710 sorting (tri), 670 composting, 120 incineration with energy recovery, 170 landfill (stockage). The treatment mix constrains what any collection system can do with sorted waste.

facts.subject: Depense gestion dechets 2022 21,6 milliards
facts.value: SDES (14/04/2025): 21.6 billion EUR spent on waste management in France in 2022, +8.5% vs 2021. This is the aggregate bill behind the 'bordel' perception - paid via TEOM/REOM and subsidies.

scope.lead_question: Pourquoi la collecte des dechets menagers est-elle si heterogene ? Determinants: organisation, financement, infrastructures.
scope.limits: pas de carte nationale des modes
scope.object_question: (1) modes de collecte par EPCI ; (2) tarification ; (3) performance et couts.

ACTOR_NETWORK_MAP.actors: Structures competentes: 1,169 (ADEME 2025) dont 6 communes en propre. Financeurs: TEOM, REOM, TI. Operateurs: collectivites/EPCI/syndicats. Regulateurs: ADEME, SDES, Insee, Senat. Usagers: menages (615kg/hab 2021).
ACTOR_NETWORK_MAP.roles: Collectivites decident (L2224-13); ADEME mesure; Senat legislait (PPL l25-049); menages paient.

COGNITIVE_MAP.map: Corpus: 4 sources officielles (Senat l25-049, ADEME TI, Insee 2055, SDES) famille A. Containers enterres (PlaceDuPro/Hellopro, famille B) ecartes du registre. Biais: chiffres 2021/2023/2025, pas de vision 2026 complete.

CONTRADICTION_LEDGER.ledger: Nuance traitee: TI accuse de depots sauvages vs etude ADEME 28 collectivites montrant le contraire. Pas d autre contradiction directe.

CREDO.credo: Le bordel de la collecte est une architecture: decentralisation juridique (L2224-13) + financement mixte historique + TEOM decouplee. TI prouvee (-31% OMR) reste marginale (7,2M vs 25M). Facture: 21,6 Mds EUR.

DIALECTICAL_MAP.adversarial: Cadre minimal si lache quil produit 1,169 systemes; investissement TI (3 ans) et TEOM decouplee creent linertie.
DIALECTICAL_MAP.steelman: La decentralisation permet l adaptation au territoire; mutualisation -2x depuis 2007.
DIALECTICAL_MAP.test: PPL l25-049 (modulation sociale) rejetee en commission = la TEOM anti-incitative nest pas remise en cause.

EDI_REPORT.edi: Aucun conflit d interet detecte dans les sources officielles.

IMPACT_MAP.impact: Financier: 21,6 Mds EUR/an. Usage: 615 kg/hab. Territorial: 1,169 structures, 72% en TEOM. Politique: PPL l25-049. Lien fresque: decheteries = 40% des DMA.

MANIPULATION_REPORT.report: Aucune manipulation detectee. Chiffres recoupes (Senat cite ADEME; Insee cite ADEME/SINOE). Ne pas presenter la TI comme panacee.

next: Carte nationale des modes de collecte par EPCI

RESOURCE_FLOW_MAP.flow: Menages 615kg/hab -> OMR 40% / separee 20% / decheteries 40% -> ~1,800 installations. Finance: TEOM 72% -> 21,6 Mds EUR.

RESPONSIBILITY_MAP.responsibility: Collectivites (L2224-13); ADEME (mesure); SDES/Insee (stats); Senat (PPL); menages (tri, facture). Aucune autorite ne centralise la coherence nationale.

SCOPING_REPORT.scope: France metro + Reunion (Insee). Hors perimetre: dechets pros, traitement detaille, REP. Limites: donnees 2021-2025.

TEMPORAL_STATE.temporal: 2007 ~2,300 structures; 2017-2023 stabilisation 1,169; 2016 TI +44%; 2021 200 collectivites TI/6,6M hab, 615kg/hab; 2022 21,6 Mds EUR; 2025 rapport Senat; 2026 7,2M hab TI.

VERIFICATION_REPORT.verification: 15 faits famille A, tiers PROBABLE. Croisement Senat/ADEME et Insee/SDES sur chiffres cles. Containers enterres (B) ecartes.
